rows.label: FACT
rows.text: The academy could not read the VPS tape from 10-30 18:31Z to 10-31 06:17Z: ops/academy.py ran the pull as a bare 'bash', which CreateProcess resolves to WSL's bash in System32 before PATH. WSL's bash cannot open the repo's Windows path (rc 127) and, given the relative path, its scp waits on a host-key prompt (a 560 s hang when reproduced). The copy on disk was the 13:29 Central pull of 10-30, 29 MB of a 42 MB day
